essence: Eight directional fire pits should be established all around within one pavilion.
Thus there should be ten fire pits in total, including a round one.
After the auspicious-day rite and sprinkling, a properly marked ritual ground should be prepared.
Having formed the seat with the praṇava, one should spread kuśa grass and flowers around it.
The image should be laid on the bed with its head oriented in the clockwise direction.
